word.title: Concept Header for the Concept of Nostr Events

conceptHeader.description: A Nostr event is the fundamental data unit of the Nostr protocol — a cryptographically signed JSON object with fields: id (SHA256 of serialized content), pubkey (author's public key), created_at (Unix timestamp), kind (integer classifying the event type), tags (array of metadata arrays), content (arbitrary string payload), and sig (Schnorr signature). Defined in NIP-01.
